name: rentemester-document-pdf-parses-v17
sql:
CREATE TABLE document_pdf_parses (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id),
  source_sha256_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_sha256_hash) = 64),
  parser_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(parser_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  parser_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(parser_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  contract_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(contract_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ok','no_text_layer','malformed_pdf','encrypted_pdf','unsupported_pdf','resource_limit')),
  error_code TEXT CHECK(error_code IS NULL OR error_code IN ('no_text_layer','malformed_pdf','encrypted_pdf','unsupported_pdf','page_limit','item_limit','text_limit')),
  page_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(page_count >= 0 AND page_count <= 200),
  item_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(item_count >= 0 AND item_count <= 200000),
  text_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(text_length >= 0 AND text_length <= 5242880),
  result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  result_sha256_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(result_sha256_hash) = 64),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CHECK((status = 'ok' AND error_code IS NULL AND page_count > 0) OR (status = 'no_text_layer' AND error_code = 'no_text_layer') OR (status IN ('malformed_pdf','encrypted_pdf','unsupported_pdf','resource_limit') AND error_code IS NOT NULL)),
  UNIQUE(document_id, source_sha256_hash, parser_id, parser_version, contract_version)
);
CREATE TABLE document_pdf_parse_pages (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  parse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES document_pdf_parses(id),
  page_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(page_number BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  width REAL NOT NULL CHECK(width > 0),
  height REAL NOT NULL CHECK(height > 0),
  rotation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rotation IN (0,90,180,270)),
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  layout_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(item_count BETWEEN 0 AND 25000),
  UNIQUE(parse_id, page_number)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_document_pdf_parses_document ON document_pdf_parses(document_id,id DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_document_pdf_parse_pages_parse ON document_pdf_parse_pages(parse_id,page_number);
CREATE TRIGGER document_pdf_parses_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON document_pdf_parses BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document pdf parses are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER document_pdf_parses_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_pdf_parses BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document pdf parses are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER document_pdf_parse_pages_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON document_pdf_parse_pages BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document pdf parse pages are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER document_pdf_parse_pages_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_pdf_parse_pages BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document pdf parse pages are append-only'); END;
